# pve_ceph_pool (Resource)

Creates and manages a Ceph pool through `POST/PUT/DELETE /nodes/{node}/ceph/pool`. The pool is cluster-scoped in Ceph; `node` only selects the management endpoint the requests go through.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

resource "pve_ceph_pool" "rbd" {
  node              = "pve1"
  name              = "rbd"
  size              = 3
  min_size          = 2
  pg_num            = 128
  pg_autoscale_mode = "on"
  application       = "rbd"
  add_storages      = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the pool. It must be unique and must not contain `:`, `/`, or whitespace.
- `node` (String) Management node the pool requests are issued against. PVE applies the change cluster-wide; any Ceph-configured node works.

### Optional

- `add_storages` (Boolean) Configure VM and CT storage entries using the new pool (create-time only; PVE defaults to false for replicated pools). The created storage entries are not managed by this resource.
- `application` (String) The application of the pool. Must be one of: `rbd`, `cephfs`, `rgw` (PVE default `rbd`).
- `crush_rule` (String) Name of the CRUSH rule used for mapping object placement in the cluster. Read back from the pool listing (`crush_rule_name`).
- `erasure_coding` (String) Create an erasure coded pool with an accompanying replicated metadata pool, as the pin's `erasure-coding` property string: `k=<int>, m=<int> [,device-class=<class>] [,failure-domain=<domain>] [,profile=<profile>]`. When set, `size`, `min_size`, and `crush_rule` apply to the metadata pool. Create-time only.
- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Destroy the pool even when it is still in use (pin `force`, default `false`).
- `min_size` (Number) Minimum number of replicas required to accept writes. Must be between 1 and 7 (PVE default 2).
- `pg_autoscale_mode` (String) The automatic PG scaling mode of the pool. Must be one of: `on`, `off`, `warn` (PVE default `warn`).
- `pg_num` (Number) Number of placement groups. Must be between 1 and 32768 (PVE default 128).
- `pg_num_min` (Number) Minimal number of placement groups the autoscaler may choose. Must be between 1 and 32768.
- `remove_storages_on_destroy` (Boolean) Remove all pveceph-managed storage entries configured for this pool on destroy (pin `remove_storages`, default `false`).
- `size` (Number) Number of replicas per object. Must be between 1 and 7 (PVE default 3).
- `target_size` (String) Estimated target size of the pool for the PG autoscaler, e.g. `10G`. Pattern: digits with optional decimal part and optional `K`, `M`, `G`, or `T` suffix.
- `target_size_ratio` (Number) Estimated target ratio of total pool capacity for the PG autoscaler.

### Read-Only

- `pool_id` (Number) Numeric pool id assigned by Ceph.
- `pool_type` (String) Pool type reported by PVE: `replicated`, `erasure`, or `unknown`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# Import an existing Ceph pool by its management node and pool name:
terraform import pve_ceph_pool.rbd pve1:rbd
```
